LESSON: PROHIBITIONS IN ISLAM

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Akhlaq 5.4 Virtues: honesty (4 lessons) By the end of the sub-strand, the learne
Topic 5.5: Prohibitions in Islam
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 8

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Prohibitions in Islam, part of Akhlaq 5.4 Virtues: honesty (4 lessons) By the end of the sub-strand, the learne in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: How does hasad and kibr come about in the society?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. research on the causes of hasad and kibr and make notes 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. research on the causes of hasad and kibr and make notes 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Prohibitions in Islam together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Digital Literacy: the skills of interacting with digital technology and connecting with technology enhanced as learners act

short skits on hasad and kibr, record and share on social media

• Communication and Collaboration: the skills of listening, speaking, writing and teamwork enhanced as learners discuss in

groups the dangers of hasad and kibr in the society and present on charts/PowerPoints

• Learning to learn: the skill of working collaboratively enhanced as learners buzz on the possible measures of curbing hasad

and kibr and present on charts

• Creativity and imagination: the skill of networking enhanced as learners act short skits on hasad and kibr, record and share

on social media as well as composing and reciting poems on the dangers of hasad and kibr in groups

Values:
● Responsibility enhanced as learners buzz on the possible measures of curbing hasad and kibr and present on charts

● Respect enhanced as learners buzz on the possible measures of curbing hasad and kibr and present on charts

● Unity enhanced as learners buzz on the measures of curbing hasad and kibr and present on charts

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
• Life skills: analytical thinking skill enhanced as learners buzz on the possible measures of curbing hasad and kibr and

present on charts as well as compose and recite a poem on the dangers of hasad and kibr in groups
